projects.title: AI-Based Resume Analyzer
projects.summary: An AI resume analyzer that extracts key information from a resume, identifies skills and qualifications, and matches the candidate profile with a job description. It helps users find skill gaps, check how relevant their resume is, and improve it for better career opportunities.
highlights: Reads PDF resumes in the browser and accepts an optional job description
Returns an overall score, an ATS score, strengths, gaps by severity, keyword matches and suggestions
Built to simplify resume evaluation and support the recruitment process with AI and NLP
